$comment: Hand off a feature, 3: check in an hour later, answer the PM's question, and come back to a resolved task.
do: caption:An hour later, check in|Open the task and read its thread.
click:text="Add a gift message to orders"

eval:(() => { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-conversation"]'); if (!c) return; let n = c; while (n && !/(auto|scroll)/.test(getComputedStyle(n).overflowY)) n = n.parentElement; if (!n) return; const go = () => n.scrollTo({ top: n.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' }); go(); new MutationObserver(go).observe(c, { childList: true, subtree: true }); })()
caption:The PM asks what it can't decide|and waits for you in the thread.
fill:Reply in Add a gift message to orders…=Yes, print it on the packing slip too.
caption:Answer in the thread|Both agents read it.
caption:The PM holds the new check like the rest
caption:Every check passes, so the PM resolves it|and you come back to a reviewed PR.
